actions.body: Traditional agent architectures rely entirely on human-assigned tasks. Recent developments in goal-based open-ended autonomous learning demonstrate that agents can self-generate goals to drive continuous skill acquisition. Summary: Autonomous systems can learn more effectively by generating their own tasks rather than relying solely on pre-assigned instructions.
actions.lede: How autonomous agents generate their own objectives rather than following static instructions.

support.passage: First, to exhibit an autonomous open-ended learning process, robots should be able to self-generate goals, and hence tasks to practice.
